label: Necessary holder of global-absence power with selected-world Euclidean access (inference)
rule: Use two successors of w to test contingency of the same power-holder at its initiating history
meaning: The global-absence power-content, grounding, initiating-history and concreteness predicates are unchanged. The global absence possibility and actual contingency give a holder at w. Initiator presence puts that holder in a successor v with no contingent concrete beings. If any successor u of w lacked it, the edge from v to u given by EuclideanAt at w would make it contingent at v. Excluded middle gives necessary existence at w. The result keeps the global power content.
